summary: The MonoLisa site (FaceType) is a long, pale-blue developer-product page for a coding superfamily (MonoLisa Code, monospaced, and MonoLisa Text, proportional; variable wght + GRAD). Short, comment-ruled sections ('/* ==== *** ==== */') each prove one design decision with a small live demo (Code/Text switches, ligature-mode tabs, grade sliders on light vs dark cards, ligature-group toggles that write a settings.json line), then a full code playground, a text tester, price cards and a team section. A 'Get MonoLisa or try in the tester' strip and a testimonial marquee recur between chapters.
